_purpose: Merge pressure on figures and dates; a filler aside; an unassigned action agreed by two speakers; a commitment reassigned later in the meeting.

discussion_points.polished_text: Arjun reported that FADEC recalibration on 12 March raised the thrust margin by 18%. Arjun agreed to circulate the calibration report to the propulsion team by 20 March.
discussion_points.speaker: Arjun

action_items.task: Circulate the FADEC calibration report to the propulsion team

discussion_points.polished_text: Meera stated that vibration on LRU-4 exceeded 2.4 g during ground run 7, and the root cause was traced to a loose mounting bracket.
discussion_points.speaker: Meera

discussion_points.polished_text: Arjun and Meera agreed that the LRU-4 mounting bracket must be replaced before the next ground run. No one was assigned to carry out the replacement.
discussion_points.speaker: Arjun

action_items.task: Replace the LRU-4 mounting bracket before the next ground run

discussion_points.polished_text: Arjun noted a fuel flow sensor drift of 0.8% that will be observed over the next 3 runs; no action was decided.
discussion_points.speaker: Arjun
